page0.text:
I listen to the rain in Tohsaka's room.
Today, under the pretense of a magecraft lesson, she performed yet another physical examination like yesterday. She gave me more medicine, then checked all my Magic Circuits.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page0:1

page1.text:
It's not that I mind doing this, I just...don't like the feeling that I'm not doing anything productive.
She tells me not to move so she can see what happens to me, but that doesn't mean I can't talk.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page1:1

page2.text:
"Tohsaka. Do you have a minute?"
I call out to her as I sit in my meditative pose.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page2:1

page3.text:
"Hm? What is it?"
"It's about Saber.
I really don't know how to explain it, but..."
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page3:1

page4.text:
I realize I haven't thought this through at all.
It's not even a question of, "What can I do for Saber?"
I haven't even thought about what I want to do with her.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page4:1

page5.text:
"Um...well...I was just wondering what she wants to do.
She's never told us anything she wants to do for herself. So..."
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page5:1

page6.text:
"You don't know what Saber's thinking?"
"Uh...no, it's not that. I just don't know why she's so selfless.
Yeah...I just don't know what to do about that."
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page6:1

page7.text:
"Huh. Well, you're right. The only thing she's done voluntarily is protect you. It may be a natural thing for a Servant to do, but I can't blame you for thinking that since she's so dedicated to doing it.
But that doesn't mean she's selfless.
Saber is protecting you because protecting you helps fulfill her goal."
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page7:1

page8.text:
"Oh..."
I completely forgot her reason for even becoming a Servant.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page8:1

page9.text: "You're right. Saber wants to get the Holy Grail. So it's not like she doesn't have any goals."
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page9:1

page10.text:
And that Holy Grail will grant its possessor's wish.
That means Saber at least has a wish she wants granted.
I don't know what it is, but she wants it enough to even become a Servant.
So it must have some hope of saving her.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page10:1

page11.text:
Like, for example...
She's here in this time period, and the power of the Holy Grail can help her so she can stay here and live a second life.
And, she would have to wish for something that big, just to make up for all the suffering and tragedy she endured.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page11:1

page12.text:
"Oh. Then it's actually pretty simple!"
"Huh? You're energetic all of a sudden... It's creeping me out. Were we talking about something fun, for you to get all excited like this?"
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page12:1

page13.text:
"Yeah. I am getting excited. And yeah...she wouldn't be fighting so hard unless it was for something real big.
After all, Saber needs to fight for her own wish!"
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page13:1

page14.text:
I nod to myself.
Tohsaka, on the other hand, seems utterly bewildered.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page14:1

page15.text: "Emiya. Sorry to rain on your parade, but you're jumping to the wrong conclusion. Saber's not fighting for her own sake."
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page15:1

page16.text: "You understand that, right? Saber isn't like that. She doesn't want the Holy Grail for herself."
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page16:1

page17.text:
"Wha...what's your reasoning?"
...I can't even ask that.
I know...
She met her final moments alone BECAUSE she didn't have any desires for herself.
So Saber wouldn't seek for her own salvation now.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page17:1

page18.text:
"...Ugh."
But still...
I hoped otherwise, even for a brief moment, so I pushed my distorted desire on her.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page18:1

page19.text:
...
"..."
Our conversation trails off.
Just as I think this awkward silence is going to continue forever...
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page19:1

page20.text:
"This might be a boring story, but Archer actually said something similar to what you said."
"Huh? Archer? You mean, your Archer?"
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page20:1

page21.text:
"Yep. I once asked him what his wish was.
And do you know what he said?"
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page21:1

page22.text:
"Eh...um...I wouldn't have the slightest idea."
I never knew a single thing about him.
Archer once declared that we were bound to be enemies anyway, so he made no effort to communicate with Saber or me.
And yet...
He may have been cynical, but he didn't seem the sort to have stupid objectives in mind.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page22:1

page23.text:
"Get this...you're going to laugh... When I asked him what his wish was, he said,
'Hm. How about world peace, forever?'
It was so ridiculous, I couldn't help laughing.
But then he got all weird and said, 'I knew you'd laugh. Well, you know there's no meaning in gaining salvation from others. Fine, let's just say this was a joke and leave it at that.'"
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page23:1

page24.text: "It made me think that that's probably why a guy like him became a Heroic Spirit to get ordered around by a girl like me."
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page24:1

page25.text:
...
I see.
He didn't look it, but he was a great, proud knight in his own right.
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page25:1

page26.text:
"But don't get the wrong idea. If the Holy Grail really grants any wish, permanent world peace would be the worst one.
It'd just mean nothing happens. If there was no conflict in the world, that'd be as good as death. If nothing happens, the only thing is to rot away from stagnation."
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page26:1

page27.text:
"Huh. Did you tell Archer that too?"
"I did. And he said, 'That's what the wise would think.
I agree, but I'm still going to follow this dream, even if it is a fool's dream.'"
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page27:1

page28.text:
"Then I pressed him about whether he had any other wishes, and he said, 'I do, but it's not a wish that should be granted by the Holy Grail. So I'll let you make your own wish in my place.'
Pretty pretentious, right? I bet he was quite the womanizer while he was alive."
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page28:1

page29.text:
"Huh. I really didn't get that impression from him. But what's your point here, Tohsaka?"
"Nothing in particular. I was just saying that there are different kinds of Servants."
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page29:1

page30.text:
Is that so?
Well, I guess it was good for me to know, so it was at least kinda helpful.
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page30:1

page31.text:
"Then let's move on to the next topic.
Well, actually this is mostly about Saber anyway."
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page31:1

page32.text: "Huh? I do remember you saying you wanted to talk to me about something this morning."
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page32:1

page33.text:
"Yes. It's nothing big, but I was curious...
Might be a bit late in the game for this, but do you know the legend of King Arthur?"
The legend of King Arthur...
I've been reminded of it more than enough in the past few days.
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page33:1

page34.text: "I know as much as the next person. Although, I didn't know King Arthur was a girl."
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page34:1

page35.text:
"Right. Her sex doesn't matter though.
King Arthur being a girl wouldn't change the legend. As long as King Arthur managed to hide that fact from everyone, she would be treated as a man anyway."
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page35:1

page36.text: "Fortunately, King Arthur had a mage called Merlin in his service. Merlin was truly devilish—half incubus, actually—so it would have been easy for him to hide King Arthur's sex, or prepare a child who shouldn't have been born."
page36.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page36:1

page37.text:
"Yeah, I bet. So?"
"So my concern is the discrepancy between the legend and the Saber we have in front of us.
Emiya. Do you know what Excalibur was?"
page37.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page37:1

page38.text:
"Why ask this now? Excalibur is a symbol of King Arthur. It's the sword fairies gave her, famed for being able to cut through anything without ever dulling."
"Yeah, that's about what I figured you'd say."
Tohsaka looks oddly triumphant.
page38.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page38:1

page39.text:
"Huh? Was that a weird thing to say?"
"Yes. You and King Arthur made the same mistake. If Merlin was around, he would probably mock you for being a fool."
page39.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page39:1

page40.text:
"Why's that?
Um...the sword in the stone wasn't Excalibur. That sword broke. He later received another sword from a fairy in the lake, and that was Excalibur, right?"
page40.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page40:1

page41.text:
"Yep. When King Arthur received Excalibur, Merlin asked,
'My king, which do you prefer?
The sword or the sheath?'"
page41.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page41:1

page42.text:
"King Arthur answered 'the sword' without a moment's hesitation. But Merlin scolded the king for that.
'Do not mistake their worth; the sword may cut your enemies, but the sheath protects you. So long as you possess that sheath, you will spill not a single drop of blood, nor sustain any injury. The sheath, rather than the blade, is what you should value.'"
page42.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page42:1

page43.text:
"..."
Tohsaka skillfully acts out the parts of King Arthur and Merlin.
page43.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page43:1

page44.text:
"Look at you, Tohsaka, you're getting into the part.
So what's your point?"
page44.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page44:1

page45.text:
"Oh come on, do you STILL not get it!? It means King Arthur is immortal! Excalibur is an invincible Noble Phantasm, in both offense and defense!
Which is why Saber should be able to heal immediately!"
page45.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page45:1

page46.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page46:1

page47.text: "Yes, that's true, but Saber's self-healing abilities come from using a great amount of magical energy. And that sounds like it's separate from the sheath of the legendary Excalibur."
page47.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page47:1

page48.text:
"I see. If you say so, it's probably true.
Then here's my question.
You say that King Arthur is immortal, so then why and how did King Arthur die? The legend ends with King Arthur's death, right?"
page48.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page48:1

page49.text:
"Huh?"
Tohsaka's mouth drops open.
After freezing up for a few seconds, she grinds her teeth and looks away.
page49.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page49:1

page50.text:
"Oh right...Excalibur's sheath was stolen..."
Ah, rookie mistake right there.
I'd forgotten, but according to legend, King Arthur's fate was sealed the moment the king lost the all-important sheath.
page50.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page50:1

page51.text:
"So are you convinced now, Tohsaka?"
"Yeah, yeah...go ahead and make fun of me if you want."
page51.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page51:1

page52.text:
She doesn't mean that.
I can tell she's ready to kick me in the head the moment I laugh at her.
page52.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page52:1

page53.text: "It's all good as long as you understand now. But why did that bother you so much? It shouldn't matter to you whether Saber gets hurt or not."
page53.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page53:1

page54.text:
"Sh-shut up! I might've just gotten a little...arrogant, thinking she would be invincible if that were the case.
I make mistakes sometimes too, you know!"
page54.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page54:1

page55.text:
"..."
This is a tough one.
Would there be any benefit in me pointing out that she makes mistakes a lot, not just sometimes?
page55.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-13:page55:1
